verdict.rationale: Remote documents global payroll and EOR across countries, plus per-country required fields via dynamic JSON schemas. Nothing in the pack covers running payroll across multiple US states, handling state tax registrations, or calculating per-state withholdings. Country-level coverage is adjacent and does not show the state-level compliance this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state
